rules: 1 all-in crypto pick per day, 100% deployed
Spot crypto only (BTC, ETH, SOL, and other liquid coins on Robinhood)
Rotate each 6:45am CT run — sell yesterday, buy today's best
Hard stop at entry; leverage conviction, protect downside

positions.name: Bitcoin
positions.catalyst: Rotate ETH->BTC on the coin with the freshest, most structural catalyst today. The White House confirmed the US is standing up an official strategic Bitcoin reserve, and the Senate is being pressed to move the CLARITY Act — a pair of BTC-specific, demand-and-legitimacy catalysts (a launched Bitcoin Security Alliance amplifies the institutional-backing narrative). BTC firmed ~+0.7% over the weekend on these headlines while the broader tape was mixed (SOL sagging to ~74.86, near the low of its $73-84 range and below its 50/100-day EMAs). On a fragile, low-edge tape, BTC pairs the day's only fresh structural bid with the deepest liquidity and lowest volatility = the best downside protection.
positions.driver: Closed ETH at 1883.86 (canonical proxy) for +$149.27 (entry 1857.43 -> +1.4%); ETH's ETF-inflow catalyst has aged a week and ETH now trades mostly as BTC beta. Rotated to BTC as the best risk-adjusted 24h setup: a genuinely fresh, idiosyncratic catalyst (US strategic reserve + CLARITY Act) plus relative strength (BTC up on the weekend while alts faded) and the strongest downside protection of the universe. Wins vs runners-up: ETH (~1883.86) is now flat/derivative with a stale catalyst; SOL (~74.86) is the weakest — sitting near range lows below key EMAs with mixed ETF flows and no fresh driver. BTC gives the cleanest asymmetric payoff with an 8% major stop.
positions.risks: Regulatory/political headline risk cuts both ways: if CLARITY Act momentum stalls or the reserve rollout details disappoint, the weekend bid can fade. Macro is the bigger threat — a hawkish 7/28-29 FOMC, higher Treasury yields and tariff/oil inflation fears could pressure the whole complex; sentiment remains fragile. A break below the ~$62.5k area would signal the reserve pop is unwinding. Hard stop 59290.49 (-8%, majors rule) caps downside while leaving room below near-term support.
